selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
狂怒
当暴怒通过强化旋风斩命中3个或更多目标时，你有20%的几率掀起一阵钢铁风暴，打击周围的敌人，造成([771.909% of Attack Power])点物理伤害并施加不堪一击。目标超过8个时造成的伤害降低。

 武器
当顺劈斩命中3个或更多目标时，你有20%的几率掀起一阵钢铁风暴，打击周围的敌人，造成([771.909% of Attack Power])点物理伤害并施加不堪一击。目标超过8个时造成的伤害降低。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Arms
When Cleave hits 3 or more targets you have a 20% chance to unleash a flurry of steel, striking all nearby enemies for (771.909% of Attack Power) Physical damage and applying Overwhelmed. Deals reduced damage beyond 8 targets.

 Fury
When Rampage hits 3 or more targets via Improved Whirlwind you have a 20% chance to unleash a flurry of steel, striking all nearby enemies for (771.909% of Attack Power) Physical damage and applying Overwhelmed. Deals reduced damage beyond 8 targets.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 剑刃风暴的每次打击都会对受影响的所有敌人施加不堪一击，使你对其造成的伤害提高1%，持续20秒，最多叠加5层。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Each strike of Bladestorm applies Overwhelmed to all enemies affected, increasing damage you deal to them by 1% for 20 sec, max 5 stacks.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 猝死造成的伤害的15%为你恢复生命值。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: You heal for 15% of damage dealt by Sudden Death.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
狂怒
你对主要目标的攻击有15%几率摧垮其防御，并触发一次屠戮者打击，造成([840.42% of Attack Power])点物理伤害，并赋予你一层处刑者效果，使你的斩杀伤害提高3%，持续12秒。处刑者效果可叠加。

 武器
你对主要目标的攻击有25%几率摧垮其防御，并触发一次屠戮者打击，造成([840.42% of Attack Power])点物理伤害，并赋予你一层处刑者效果，使你的斩杀伤害提高3%，持续12秒。处刑者效果可叠加。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Fury
Your attacks against your primary target have a 15% chance to overwhelm their defenses and trigger a Slayer's Strike, dealing (840.42% of Attack Power) Physical damage and granting you a stack of Executioner, increasing your Execute damage by 3% for 12 sec. Multiple stacks of Executioner may overlap.

 Arms
Your attacks against your primary target have a 25% chance to overwhelm their defenses and trigger a Slayer's Strike, dealing (840.42% of Attack Power) Physical damage and granting you a stack of Executioner, increasing your Execute damage by 3% for 12 sec. Multiple stacks of Executioner may overlap.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
使用猝死会使你的剑刃风暴冷却时间缩短5秒，并根据你拥有的处刑者层数，为你的主要目标施加1层不堪一击效果。

你可以在剑刃风暴期间使用拳击和风暴之锤。

剑刃风暴的伤害提高20%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Using Sudden Death causes you to both reduce the cooldown of Bladestorm by 5 sec and apply 1 stack of Overwhelmed to your primary target per stack of Executioner you have.

You can use Pummel and Storm Bolt while Bladestorming.

Bladestorm damage increased by 20%.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 专注于无情追杀和毁灭性的利刃风暴，强化斩杀与压制/怒击，引发不可阻挡的钢铁乱舞。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Focuses on relentless pursuit and devastating Bladestorms, empowering Execute and Overpower/Raging Blow into an unstoppable flurry of steel.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
狂怒
当怒击重置自身的冷却时间时，你的下一个怒击造成的伤害提高10%，爆击伤害提高10%。此效果最多叠加2层。

 武器
当战术专家重置压制的冷却时间时，你的下一个压制造成的伤害提高20%，爆击伤害提高20%。此效果最多叠加2层。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Arms
When Overpower has its cooldown reset by Tactician, your next Overpower deals 20% additional damage and 20% additional critical damage. Stacking up to 2 times.

 Fury
When Raging Blow resets its own cooldown, your next Raging Blow deals 10% additional damage and 10% additional critical damage. Stacking up to 2 times.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 如果顺劈斩或旋风斩命中了至少3个目标，你还会对你的主要目标施放猛击。此次猛击额外造成50%的伤害。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: If Cleave or Whirlwind hits 3 or more targets you also Slam your primary target. This Slam deals 50% additional damage.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 当横扫攻击期间使用的技能伤害第二个目标时，你的下一个顺劈斩或旋风斩伤害提高25%，最多叠加3次。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: When an ability used during Sweeping Strikes damages a second target, your next Cleave or Whirlwind deals 25% increased damage, stacking up to 3 times.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 巨人打击立即使你获得1次使用猝死的机会。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Colossus Smash immediately grants 1 use of Sudden Death.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 斩杀对目标造成重伤。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Execute inflicts Deep Wounds on the target.

subSpellsCn.name: 重伤
subSpellsCn.description: 使目标在6秒内受到([145.48% of Attack Power])点流血伤害。如果刷新此效果，所有剩余伤害将添加到新的重伤效果中。

subSpellsEn.name: Deep Wounds
subSpellsEn.description: Causes the target to suffer (145.48% of Attack Power) Bleed damage over 6 sec. If this effect is reapplied, any remaining damage will be added to the new Deep Wounds.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 致死打击和猛击的爆击会以100%的效果造成重伤。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Mortal Strike and Slam critical strikes inflict Deep Wounds at 100% effectiveness.

subSpellsCn.name: 重伤
subSpellsCn.description: 使目标在6秒内受到([145.48% of Attack Power])点流血伤害。如果刷新此效果，所有剩余伤害将添加到新的重伤效果中。

subSpellsEn.name: Deep Wounds
subSpellsEn.description: Causes the target to suffer (145.48% of Attack Power) Bleed damage over 6 sec. If this effect is reapplied, any remaining damage will be added to the new Deep Wounds.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 巨人打击使你获得6层横扫攻击。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Colossus Smash grants 6 stacks of Sweeping Strikes.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
压制和猛击的伤害提高5%，爆击伤害提高5%。
猛击和压制的爆击几率提高5%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Overpower and Slam damage increased by 5% and critical strike damage increased by 5%.
Critical strike chance of Slam and Overpower increased by 5%.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
狂怒
剑刃风暴每攻击2次，你会自动向目标或附近的随机敌人施放一次嗜血，造成100%的普通伤害。

 武器
剑刃风暴每攻击2次，你会自动向目标或附近的随机敌人施放一次致死打击，造成100%的普通伤害。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Fury
Every 2 strikes of Bladestorm, you automatically cast a Bloodthirst at your target or random nearby enemy, dealing 100% of normal damage.

 Arms
Every 2 strikes of Bladestorm, you automatically cast a Mortal Strike at your target or random nearby enemy, dealing 100% of normal damage.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 处刑者的持续时间延长6秒。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Executioner's duration is increased by 6 sec.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 剑刃风暴使你进入战斗沉醉状态，在剑刃风暴结束后，使你获得15%的急速，持续8秒。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Bladestorm puts you into a battle trance, granting you 15% haste for 8 sec after you stop Bladestorming.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
防护
化身为巨人，使你造成的所有伤害提高20%，受到的所有伤害降低3%持续20秒。

 武器
化身为巨人，使你造成的所有伤害提高20%，受到的范围攻击伤害降低5%持续20秒。

 狂怒
化身为巨人，使你造成的所有伤害提高20%，移动速度提高5%持续20秒。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Fury
Transform into a colossus, increasing all damage you deal by 20% and increasing your movement speed by 5% for 20 sec.

 Protection
Transform into a colossus, increasing all damage you deal by 20% and reducing all damage you take by 3% for 20 sec.

 Arms
Transform into a colossus, increasing all damage you deal by 20% and reducing damage you take from area of effect attacks by 5% for 20 sec.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 英勇打击会强化你下一次的巨人打击，使其对敌人造成的伤害额外提高3.0%。该效果最多可叠加5次。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Heroic Strike increases the damage you deal to enemies affected by your next Colossus Smash by an additional 3.0%. Stacks up to 5 times.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 每层战争大师使致死打击、顺劈斩和压制的伤害提高2.5%，爆击伤害提高2.5%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Each stack of Master of Warfare increases Mortal Strike, Cleave, and Overpower damage by 2.5% and critical strike damage by 2.5%.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
你的单一目标近战技能有几率将猛击升级为英勇打击。
所有影响猛击的效果和天赋同样会影响英勇打击。

 
英勇打击20怒气近战范围瞬发
Requires Warrior
Requires level 1需要近战武器
强力打击一名对手，造成([600% of Attack Power])点物理伤害，并获得一层战争大师效果，使你的攻击无视3%的护甲，持续30秒。多次使用可叠加此效果。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Your single target melee abilities have a chance to upgrade Slam to Heroic Strike.
All modifiers and talents that affect Slam also affect Heroic Strike.

 
Heroic Strike20 RageMelee RangeInstant
Requires Warrior
Requires level 1Requires Melee Weapon
Powerfully strike an opponent, causing (600% of Attack Power) Physical damage and gaining a stack of Master of Warfare, allowing your attacks to penetrate 3% armor for 30 sec. Multiple applications of this effect may overlap.
